mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT unnest(ARRAY[owner_name,owner_phone,claim_no,policy_no,vehicle_vin,vehicle_plate, vehicle_other_identifier,accident_address,parking_address]) AS value FROM work_order UNION ALL SELECT unnest(ARRAY[display_name,contact_phone]) FROM owner_profile UNION ALL SELECT unnest(ARRAY[owner_name,owner_phone,claim_no,vehicle_plate,accident_address]) FROM historical_case UNION ALL SELECT unnest(ARRAY[owner_name,claim_no]) FROM formal_quote_document_header UNION ALL SELECT transaction_no FROM funds_entry UNION ALL SELECT raw_json::jsonb ->> 'transactionNo' FROM funds_import_row ) protected_values CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT nullif(regexp_replace(lower(normalize(value, NFKC)), '[[:space:][:punct:]]+', '', 'g'), '') AS normalized_value) normalized WHERE CASE WHEN normalized_value ~ '^[0-9]{1,3}$' THEN #{text} ~ ('(^|[^0-9])' || normalized_value || '([^0-9]|$)') ELSE strpos(#{text}, normalized_value) > 0 END )

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(a.amount), 0) AS total_cny FROM work_order w JOIN quotation_context q ON q.work_order_id = w.id AND q.insurer_confirmed AND q.service_confirmed JOIN quote_assessment a ON a.id = q.assessment_id AND a.work_order_id = w.id AND a.source_formal_id = q.formal_quote_id WHERE TRUE
mapper.sql: COALESCE(SUM(e.amount) FILTER (WHERE e.direction = 'RECEIVE'), 0) AS received, COALESCE(SUM(e.amount) FILTER (WHERE e.direction = 'PAY'), 0) AS paid
NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM funds_reversal reversal WHERE reversal.entry_id = e.id)

EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_log upload WHERE upload.object_type = 'CASE_FILE' AND upload.object_id = CAST(f.id AS text) AND upload.action = 'FILE_UPLOAD' AND upload.actor_id = f.uploaded_by AND 'REPAIR_SHOP' = ANY(string_to_array(upload.actor_roles, ',')))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM funds_entry e WHERE e.occurred_at >= #{start} AND e.occurred_at < #{end} AND

WITH selected AS ( SELECT w.id, w.business_no, w.status, AS selected_at FROM work_order w
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.occurred_at FROM work_order_status_history h WHERE h.work_order_id = w.id AND h.to_status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY h.occurred_at DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT 1) completion ON true
WHERE w.business_no ~ '^EVR-[0-9]{8}-[0-9]{6}$' AND w.status = 'COMPLETED' AND >= #{start} AND < #{end} ORDER BY selected_at DESC, w.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) SELECT selected.business_no, selected.status, selected.selected_at, formal.total AS formal_quote, a.amount AS assessment, completed.insurance, completed.payable, completed.profit, net.received, net.paid FROM selected LEFT JOIN quotation_context q ON q.work_order_id = selected.id LEFT JOIN quote_formal formal ON formal.id = q.formal_quote_id AND formal.work_order_id = selected.id AND formal.raw_quote_id = q.raw_quote_id LEFT JOIN quote_assessment a ON a.id = q.assessment_id AND a.work_order_id = selected.id AND a.source_formal_id = formal.id AND q.insurer_confirmed AND q.service_confirmed LEFT JOIN funds_analytics_fact completed ON completed.id = selected.id AND completed.pending_reason IS NULL CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT FROM funds_entry e WHERE e.work_order_id = selected.id AND ) net ORDER BY selected.selected_at DESC, selected.id DESC

SELECT w.status, w.deletion_pending, w.dispatch_address_confirmed, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM case_file f WHERE f.work_order_id = w.id AND f.state = 'ACTIVE' AND f.category = 'SCENE_PHOTO') scene_photo_present, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM case_file f WHERE f.work_order_id = w.id AND f.state = 'ACTIVE' AND f.category = 'ARRIVAL_PHOTO' AND f.shop_id = assignment.shop_id AND f.assignment_version = assignment.assignment_version AND f.content_type IN ('image/jpeg', 'image/png') AND ) arrival_photo_present, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM case_file f WHERE f.work_order_id = w.id AND f.state = 'ACTIVE' AND f.category = 'COMPLETION_PHOTO' AND f.shop_id = assignment.shop_id AND f.assignment_version = assignment.assignment_version AND f.content_type IN ('image/jpeg', 'image/png') AND ) completion_photo_present, raw.total AS raw_total, formal.total AS formal_total, a.amount AS assessed, COALESCE(q.insurer_confirmed, false) insurer_confirmed, COALESCE(q.service_confirmed, false) service_confirmed, COALESCE(q.authorized, false) AND w.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'COMPLETED', 'CLOSED') authorized, receiver.amount receive_target, payee.amount pay_target, net.received, net.paid, CASE WHEN q.insurer_confirmed AND q.service_confirmed AND a.id IS NOT NULL AND confirmation.file_snapshot::jsonb #>> '{financialBasis,profitAmount}' ~ '^-?[0-9]{1,36}([.][0-9]{1,2})?$' THEN (confirmation.file_snapshot::jsonb #>> '{financialBasis,profitAmount}')::numeric(38,2) END profit FROM work_order w LEFT JOIN work_order_assignment assignment ON assignment.work_order_id = w.id AND assignment.status = 'ACCEPTED' LEFT JOIN quotation_context q ON q.work_order_id = w.id LEFT JOIN quote_raw raw ON raw.id = q.raw_quote_id AND raw.work_order_id = w.id AND raw.shop_id = assignment.shop_id AND raw.assignment_version = assignment.assignment_version LEFT JOIN quote_formal formal ON formal.id = q.formal_quote_id AND formal.work_order_id = w.id AND formal.raw_quote_id = raw.id LEFT JOIN quote_assessment a ON a.id = q.assessment_id AND a.work_order_id = w.id AND a.source_formal_id = formal.id LEFT JOIN quotation_confirmation confirmation ON confirmation.work_order_id = w.id AND confirmation.kind = 'CUSTOMER_SERVICE' AND confirmation.basis_version = q.basis_version AND confirmation.assessment_id = a.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT amount FROM funds_target WHERE work_order_id = w.id AND direction = 'RECEIVE' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) receiver ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT amount FROM funds_target WHERE work_order_id = w.id AND direction = 'PAY' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) payee ON true CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT FROM funds_entry e WHERE e.work_order_id = w.id AND ) net WHERE w.business_no = #{number}

WITH current_quote AS ( SELECT w.id, q.assessment_id, q.formal_quote_id, raw.id raw_id, assignment.shop_id, assignment.assignment_version FROM work_order w JOIN quotation_context q ON q.work_order_id = w.id JOIN work_order_assignment assignment ON assignment.work_order_id = w.id AND assignment.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND assignment.shop_id = w.shop_id JOIN quote_raw raw ON raw.id = q.raw_quote_id AND raw.work_order_id = w.id AND raw.shop_id = assignment.shop_id AND raw.assignment_version = assignment.assignment_version WHERE w.business_no = #{number} AND NOT w.deletion_pending ), values_only AS ( SELECT 'SHOP_QUOTE' AS kind, item.line_no, item.quantity, item.unit_price, item.amount FROM current_quote q JOIN quote_raw_item item ON item.raw_quote_id = q.raw_id WHERE ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quote_raw_ocr_line line JOIN shop_quote_ocr_scope scope ON scope.job_id = line.job_id AND scope.work_order_id = q.id AND scope.shop_id = q.shop_id AND scope.assignment_version = q.assignment_version JOIN ocr_job j ON j.id = line.job_id AND j.state = 'SUCCEEDED' AND j.review_version = line.revision JOIN ocr_confirmation checked ON checked.job_id = j.id AND checked.revision = line.revision JOIN case_file f ON f.id = j.file_id AND f.work_order_id = q.id AND f.category = scope.category AND f.state = 'ACTIVE' AND f.shop_id = q.shop_id AND f.assignment_version = q.assignment_version WHERE line.raw_quote_id = item.raw_quote_id AND line.line_no = item.line_no ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workflow_recognition_link link JOIN ocr_job j ON j.id = link.job_id AND j.file_id = link.file_id AND j.state = 'SUCCEEDED' AND j.review_version = link.revision JOIN ocr_confirmation checked ON checked.job_id = j.id AND checked.revision = link.revision JOIN case_file f ON f.id = link.file_id AND f.work_order_id = q.id AND f.category = 'SHOP_QUOTE' AND f.state = 'ACTIVE' AND f.shop_id = q.shop_id AND f.assignment_version = q.assignment_version WHERE link.business_id = q.raw_id AND link.work_order_id = q.id AND link.kind = 'QUOTE' AND link.recognition_state = 'SUCCEEDED' ) ) UNION ALL SELECT 'LOSS_ASSESSMENT', 0, NULL::integer, NULL::numeric, a.amount FROM current_quote q JOIN quote_formal formal ON formal.id = q.formal_quote_id AND formal.raw_quote_id = q.raw_id AND formal.work_order_id = q.id JOIN quote_assessment a ON a.id = q.assessment_id AND a.source_formal_id = formal.id AND a.work_order_id = q.id JOIN workflow_recognition_link link ON link.business_id = a.id AND link.work_order_id = q.id AND link.kind = 'ASSESSMENT' AND link.recognition_state = 'SUCCEEDED' JOIN ocr_job j ON j.id = link.job_id AND j.file_id = link.file_id AND j.state = 'SUCCEEDED' AND j.review_version = link.revision JOIN ocr_confirmation checked ON checked.job_id = j.id AND checked.revision = link.revision JOIN ocr_review reviewed ON reviewed.job_id = j.id AND reviewed.revision = link.revision WHERE reviewed.candidate_json::jsonb -> 'originalReviewed' = 'true'::jsonb AND jsonb_typeof(reviewed.candidate_json::jsonb -> 'adopted') = 'string' AND CASE WHEN reviewed.candidate_json::jsonb ->> 'adopted' ~ '^[0-9]{1,36}([.][0-9]{1,2})?$' THEN (reviewed.candidate_json::jsonb ->> 'adopted')::numeric(38,2) = a.amount ELSE false END AND link.file_id = (SELECT f.id FROM case_file f WHERE f.work_order_id = q.id AND f.category = 'LOSS_ASSESSMENT' AND f.state = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT 1) ) SELECT kind, line_no, quantity, unit_price, amount, COUNT(*) OVER () AS matched_count FROM values_only WHERE kind = #{kind} ORDER BY kind, line_no LIMIT 20
